title: When a term evaluates to minus one
statement: Let $T$ be a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates, with no coordinate appearing more than once, and let $x\in\{\pm1\}^n$. The term evaluates to $-1$ at $x$ if and only if every literal in $T$ requires the sign that $x$ has at its coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a conjunction of literals on $n$ coordinates with distinct coordinates
